name: std::ranges::subrange_kind
intro: Specifies if a std::ranges::subrange models std::ranges::sized_range or not.

sections.title: Constants
sections.text:
Name

 Explanation




 unsized

 specifies that the subrange does not model sized_range




 sized

 specifies that the subrange does model sized_range
